messages:
marta: Quick pulse on the benchmark narrative — want a compact story that PMs can act on. Idea: 'velocity slab' a narrow band showing best ROI points. Need hero scatter + slab overlay, a mini fat-tail view, and a 1-row routing table for lead handling. Draft deck Fri.

sam: 'Velocity slab' reads product-friendly. Suggest hero headline: 'Match latency velocity to your unit economics.' Keep CTA: free micro-bench.

liv: Visuals: 3 panels. 1) hero scatter (median latency vs $/1k) with shaded slab, 2) violin or p95 inset, 3) small stacked cost-breakdown. Will mock light/dark.

alex: I'll run microbenches for chat 128/256 and embed 1k across hosted/dedicated/int8. Posting CSV link and median/p95/cost/tps.

bench-bot: Run finished: dataset microbench-2026-09. hosted: median 142ms p95 440ms $0.15/1k tps 7.1k. dedicated: median 47ms p95 122ms $0.072/1k tps 30.4k. int8: median 69ms p95 190ms $0.049/1k tps 24.2k. CSV: /bench/microbench-2026-09/summary.csv

noah: Routing rules: form tag 'bench-request'. If est ARR > 50k -> AE. If selects 'private' -> Enterprise + Security. If requests 'dedicated' or qps>5k -> Solutions Eng. Add checkbox: 'Prioritize performance-first follow-up'.

liv: Those numbers are perfect. I'll add percent p95 improvements (hosted->dedicated/int8) as tiny annotations.

sam: Webinar flow: short intro, live micro-bench demo showing slab movement, engineering levers (routing, quant, batching), customer vignette, CTA. 20m + Qs.

marta: Action items: alex -> final CSV + percent deltas (EOD). liv -> PNG mocks (AM). noah -> RevOps routing rules draft. sam -> webinar outline and demo script. I'll assemble the deck and send around for one quick pass. Thanks! :rocket:
